scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Riverview post-concert quiet recovery block usable before the overnight hotel transfer.
Emerging Need: Venue access rules require either an active badge or a rostered day code, and the existing badge is no longer valid for the future recovery-room window.
Decision Context: A saved recovery plan identifies when a reserved quiet room matters and limits any venue outreach to a reviewable logistics message; current schedule updates define whether that plan applies.
Consequence: Missing the roster window leaves the recovery room unavailable before any attempt to use it begins, even though the concert and transfer still proceed.

parameter.body: For Friday's visiting-artist quiet recovery room, each user must either have an active Riverview guest badge or be added to the day-code roster by Thursday, January 15 at 12:00 PM. No day-of additions can be made after codes are generated.
